About — Malene Volf Munch 0 Gå til indhold HOME PATTERN LIBRARY STUDIO PATTERN DESIGN SERVICES CLIENTS CONTACT ABOUT Åbn menu Luk menu HOME PATTERN LIBRARY STUDIO PATTERN DESIGN SERVICES CLIENTS CONTACT ABOUT Åbn menu Luk menu HOME PATTERN LIBRARY Mappe: STUDIO Tilbage PATTERN DESIGN SERVICES CLIENTS CONTACT ABOUT ABOUT TRANSFORMING STORIES INTO BOLD VISUAL STATEMENTS I’m Malene Volf Munch – Danish pattern designer, illustrator, and artist. Rooted in the landscapes of North Zealand, I draw inspiration from the sea and the surrounding nature, transforming it into bold, sophisticated visuals infused with energy and emotion. Graduated from the Danish Design School (KADK), I bring decades of experience from the fashion and lifestyle industries, merging artistic sensibility with technical precision. My work combines expressive storytelling with refined craftsmanship — creating prints and illustrations that bring identity and atmosphere to life. Each piece is designed as a visual statement, artful and made to stand out. Foto: Olivia Amraoui Volf About Contact Follow Home Copyright by Malene Volf Munch 2025

PATTERN DESIGN — Malene Volf Munch 0 Gå til indhold HOME PATTERN LIBRARY STUDIO PATTERN DESIGN SERVICES CLIENTS CONTACT ABOUT Åbn menu Luk menu HOME PATTERN LIBRARY STUDIO PATTERN DESIGN SERVICES CLIENTS CONTACT ABOUT Åbn menu Luk menu HOME PATTERN LIBRARY Mappe: STUDIO Tilbage PATTERN DESIGN SERVICES CLIENTS CONTACT ABOUT SURFACE PATTERN DESIGN FOR FASHION, INTERIORS & LIFESTYLE PATTERN DESIGN Rich in detail, strong in identity - designed to elevate your product universe. Exclusive and Non-exclusive The Pattern Library is reserved for clients and industry professionals only. Pattern Library Application CUSTOM PRINT DESIGN Together we will tailor your designs to match your brand's identity, ensuring they align perfectly with your aesthetic and target audience. I will help you create a bespoke seamless pattern or placement print - tailored to your specific requirement. I can turn your ideas into reality with my creativity and experience in surface pattern design, whether you have your own motifs or need something uniquely tailored. I can create new surface patterns, embellishment or embroidery designs from existing artwork, by transforming it to match your style. By transforming existing motifs (like the Moroccan tiles), I offer customized artwork solutions that emphasize your brand identity. If you have any specific wishes or preferences, that you would like to discuss further, send my a short brief. I am truly excited to hear about your unique visions and collaborate on bringing them to life in an inspiring and impactful way! Let's collaborate to create stunning artwork design that inspire and engage your audience. For professional enquiries regarding licensing or bespoke print development, you are also welcome to contact: info@malenevolfmunch.com View custom-made surface prints TERMS & PRICES Learn more about licensing terms and prices by clicking on the link below Terms and Prices About Contact Follow Home Copyright by Malene Volf Munch 2025
